hypothesis.proposal: Keep attempt_1 unchanged and use a distinct prediction from another D4 hypothesis as attempt_2 only when teacher-fitted D4 models disagree on the query.
hypothesis.scope: D4 model family only; this does not evaluate alternative outputs from every HDS family.
hypothesis.baseline: Current Kaggle adapter duplicates the selected answer or neutral input fallback across both attempts.

training_leave_one_out.interpretation: The D4-only candidate generator produced no distinct second prediction in the applicable LOO folds. This is a proxy measurement, not full HDS cross-validation.

decision.reason: No D4 disagreement or distinct alternate was observed in public-training LOO or official test challenge inputs; no measured LOO gain supports this D4-specific change.
